fact: The Sudanese Cybersecurity Authority announced its official launch, mandated to lead national cybersecurity policy and regulatory frameworks.

The Sudan Computer Emergency Response Team, at the Telecommunications and Post Regulatory Authority, is stated to operate and protect the state's information infrastructure; it ran a training workshop that ended 18 December 2025.
The Sudanese Cybersecurity Authority is stated to implement the SUDAPASS digital identity project launched on 21 May 2026.
The Sudanese Cybersecurity Authority officially launched the National Root Key for the Public Key Infrastructure at a ceremony.

Sudan's Justice Ministry undersecretary told an Arab experts meeting in Tunis that a cybersecurity agency has been created; the source gives no date for its creation, so as_of is the publication date, 2026-07-30.

Prime Minister Kamil Idris signed a decree on 5 November 2025 establishing the Sudanese Cybersecurity Authority, with two other authorities, under the Ministry of Digital Transformation and Communications.
source_slug: 2025-11-07 Sudan Establishes Three Digital Authorities to Advance E-Govt

fact: The Sudanese Cybersecurity Authority states it protects the national cyberspace and runs a National Cyber Incident Response Center (Sudan-CERT).
The document states Sudan-CERT, the national incident response centre of the national cybersecurity authority, exists and issued the warning.
The document states Sudan-CERT issued a high-level security warning on 1 November 2025 about a ransomware wave targeting small and medium businesses.
